title: 上部 凡尘问道 第7章 矿洞内灵气逆流术上部 凡尘问道 第8章 监工恨栽赃与反制
content_zh:
第1节配额压顶，无灵根绝境
西坡矿洞的废矿道内，岩壁上的矿石泛着暗淡的青光，灵气稀薄得几乎可以忽略不计。
凌无妄握着鹤嘴锄，连续凿了半个时辰，只挖出三块下品灵石，距离王坤要求的十块配额还差一大截。更让他焦急的是，太阳已经西斜，留给他们的时间只剩下不到三个时辰。
“无妄，这样下去不行啊。”凌母擦了擦额头的汗水，她只是凡人，挖矿对她来说体力消耗极大，“这废矿道的灵石太少了，我们就算挖到天黑，也挖不够十块。”
凌小雨的小手已经磨出了水泡，她咬着嘴唇，倔强地挥动着小锄头“无妄哥，我还能坚持，我们再试试。”
苏晚晴看着两人疲惫的样子，心中不忍“你们先休息一下，我去前面探探，看看有没有灵气更浓郁的矿脉。”
她刚走没几步，就被一道身影拦住。赵虎带着两名跟班，双手抱胸，堵在矿道路口，脸上满是幸灾乐祸“怎么？挖不动了？我早就说过，废矿道根本挖不出灵石，你们这些废物，注定完不成配额。”
“让开！”苏晚晴眼神一冷。
“让开可以，但得答应我一个条件。”赵虎舔了舔嘴唇，目光落在苏晚晴身上，“只要你陪我一晚，我就把我矿道里的灵石分你十块，保你们过关。”
“无耻！”凌小雨气得满脸通红。
凌无妄按住想要动手的苏晚晴，冷冷地看着赵虎“我们的事，不用你操心。配额我们会自己完成，不劳你费心。”
“自己完成？”赵虎嗤笑一声，“就凭你这个无灵根的废物？我告诉你，在杂役营，没有灵根就等于没有活路！今天完不成配额，你们就得去罚灵窟受罚，那里灵气紊乱，凡人进去不出半个时辰就会被灵气反噬而死！”
系统面板突然弹出提示【警告！距离配额截止时间2小时30分钟。检测到罚灵窟内存在高强度灵气乱流，附带“噬灵”效果，进入者将被抽取生命力】
【检测到灵石与矿工的能量互动规则灵石释放灵气→修士吸收灵气→灵气转化为挖矿动力→灵石能量耗尽。但存在逆向操作可能】
凌无妄心中一动，他之前就觉得灵气的流动不该只有吸收这一种方式。他看向手中的下品灵石，运转规则之眼，仔细观察灵石内部的能量结构——
灵石内的灵气呈稳定的固态，修士吸收时，是通过功法引导灵气转化为气态，再融入自身经脉。但如果反过来，将自身的微弱能量（哪怕是凡人的气血之力）反向注入灵石，是否能刺激灵石快速释放灵气，从而让矿石更容易碎裂？
“我来试试。”凌无妄拦住想要争辩的苏晚晴，拿起一块刚挖出的灵石，握在手中。
他没有运转任何功法（事实上他也无法运转），只是集中精神，将自身的气血之力通过掌心，缓慢地注入灵石之中。
第2节逆流破局，引流术初成
气血之力注入灵石的瞬间，凌无妄清晰地感觉到，灵石内部的固态灵气被激活，开始剧烈波动起来。他立刻挥动鹤嘴锄，朝着旁边的矿石凿去。

“铛！”
鹤嘴锄落在矿石上，原本坚硬无比的矿石竟然瞬间碎裂，里面藏着的两块下品灵石滚落出来。
“这……这怎么可能？”赵虎瞪大了眼睛，满脸难以置信。
凌母和凌小雨也惊呆了，刚才他们凿了半天都没动静的矿石，竟然被凌无妄一锄就凿开了。
“无妄哥，你是怎么做到的？”凌小雨惊喜地问道。
“我只是找到了一种刺激灵石释放灵气的方法。”凌无妄心中狂喜，他的猜想果然没错，灵气并非只能吸收，还能逆向引导。
他将自己的发现快速整理“灵石内的灵气需要能量触发才能活跃，我们可以将自身的气血或灵气反向注入灵石，激活其内部能量，让矿石结构变得松散，这样挖矿就会轻松很多。”
苏晚晴立刻明白了“你的意思是，通过逆向引导灵气，来提高挖矿效率？”
“没错。”凌无妄点点头，“我把这种方法叫做‘灵气引流术’，不需要灵根，只要能控制自身的能量，就能使用。”
他立刻开始指导凌母和凌小雨“掌心对准矿石，集中精神，将体内的力气慢慢注入，就像给矿石‘输血’一样，感受到矿石震动后，再动手凿击。”
凌母和凌小雨按照他的方法尝试，虽然一开始不太熟练，但很快就找到了窍门。凌母一掌按在矿石上，感受到轻微的震动后，挥动鹤嘴锄，果然轻松凿开了矿石，里面藏着一块下品灵石。
“成功了！我们成功了！”凌小雨兴奋地跳了起来。
content_en:
Section 1: The quota is pushed to the limit, and there is no spiritual root.
In the abandoned mine tunnel of the Xipo Mine, the ore on the rock wall glowed with a dim blue light, and the spiritual energy was so thin that it was almost negligible.
Ling Wuwang held the pickaxe and dug continuously for half an hour. He only dug out three low-grade spiritual stones, which was still a long way from the ten-piece quota required by Wang Kun. What made him even more anxious was that the sun had already set in the west, leaving them less than three hours.
"Wuwang, we can't go on like this." Ling's mother wiped the sweat from her forehead. She was only a mortal, and mining was a great physical exertion for her. "There are too few spiritual stones in this abandoned mine. Even if we dig until dark, we won't be able to dig out ten pieces."
Ling Xiaoyu's little hands had already developed blisters. She bit her lip and waved the hoe stubbornly, "Brother Wuwang, I can still hold on, let's try again."
Su Wanqing looked at the tired look of the two people and couldn't bear to say, "You guys take a rest first. I'll go explore the front to see if there are any mineral veins with stronger spiritual energy."
She had just taken a few steps when she was stopped by a figure. Zhao Hu and his two followers stood at the intersection of the mine road with their hands folded, and their faces were full of gloating: "What? Can't dig anymore? I've said long ago that there is no way to dig out spiritual stones from the abandoned mine road. You wastes are destined to fail to fulfill the quota."
"Get out of the way!" Su Wanqing's eyes turned cold.
"You can get out of the way, but you have to agree to a condition." Zhao Hu licked his lips and looked at Su Wanqing. "As long as you stay with me for one night, I will give you ten pieces of the spiritual stones in my mine to ensure that you pass the test."
"Shameless!" Ling Xiaoyu's face turned red with anger.
Ling Wuwang held down Su Wanqing, who was about to take action, and looked at Zhao Hu coldly, "You don't need to worry about our affairs. We will complete the quota ourselves, so you don't have to worry about it."
"Do it by yourself?" Zhao Hu sneered, "Just because you are a waste without spiritual roots? Let me tell you, in the handyman camp, no spiritual roots means no way to survive! If you fail to meet the quota today, you will have to go to the Penalty Spirit Cave to be punished. The spiritual energy there is disordered, and mortals will be killed by the spiritual energy within half an hour of entering!"
The system panel suddenly pops up a prompt [Warning! There are 2 hours and 30 minutes until the quota deadline. It is detected that there is a high-intensity spiritual energy turbulence in the Penalty Spirit Cave, with a "spiritual eating" effect, and the life force of those who enter will be drained]
[The energy interaction rules between the spirit stone and the miner are detected. The spirit stone releases spiritual energy → the monk absorbs the spiritual energy → the spiritual energy is converted into mining power → the energy of the spiritual stone is exhausted. But there is a possibility of reverse operation]
Ling Wuwang's heart moved. He had felt before that the flow of spiritual energy should not only be absorbed. He looked at the low-grade spirit stone in his hand, used the eye of operation rules, and carefully observed the energy structure inside the spirit stone——
The spiritual energy in the spiritual stone is in a stable solid state. When the monk absorbs it, he uses his skills to guide the spiritual energy to transform into a gaseous state, and then integrates into his own meridians. But if you reverse it and inject your own weak energy (even the power of mortal blood) into the spirit stone, will it stimulate the spirit stone to quickly release spiritual energy, making the ore more easily broken?
"I'll give it a try." Ling Wuwang stopped Su Wanqing who was about to argue, picked up a newly dug spirit stone and held it in his hand.
He didn't operate any techniques (in fact, he couldn't operate them), he just concentrated on slowly injecting the power of his own energy and blood into the spirit stone through his palms.
In the second quarter, the countercurrent breaks the situation and the drainage technique is initially developed.
The moment the power of Qi and blood was injected into the spirit stone, Ling Wuwang clearly felt that the solid spiritual energy inside the spirit stone was activated and began to fluctuate violently. He immediately swung the pickaxe and struck at the ore nearby.
"Cang!"
The pickaxe fell on the ore, and the originally extremely hard ore shattered instantly, and the two low-grade spiritual stones hidden inside rolled out.
"This...how is this possible?" Zhao Hu's eyes widened with disbelief on his face.
Ling's mother and Ling Xiaoyu were also shocked. The ore that they had been digging for a long time without any movement was actually struck by Ling.Wuwu opened it with a hoe.
"Brother Wuwang, how did you do it?" Ling Xiaoyu asked in surprise.
"I just found a way to stimulate the spirit stone to release spiritual energy." Ling Wuwang was ecstatic. His guess was indeed correct. Spiritual energy can not only be absorbed, but can also be directed in the opposite direction.
He quickly organized his findings, "The aura in the spirit stone needs to be triggered by energy to become active. We can reversely inject our own blood or aura into the spirit stone to activate its internal energy and loosen the ore structure, making mining much easier."
Su Wanqing immediately understood, "You mean to improve mining efficiency by guiding spiritual energy in the reverse direction?"
"That's right." Ling Wuwang nodded, "I call this method 'Spiritual Qi Drainage Technique'. It does not require spiritual roots. As long as you can control your own energy, you can use it."
He immediately began to instruct Ling Mu and Ling Xiaoyu to "aim the palms of the hands at the ore, concentrate, and slowly inject the strength in the body, just like a 'blood transfusion' into the ore. After feeling the vibration of the ore, start chipping."
Ling Mu and Ling Xiaoyu tried his method. Although they were not very skilled at first, they soon found the trick. Ling's mother pressed her palm on the ore. After feeling a slight vibration, she swung the pickaxe and as expected, she easily cut through the ore. There was a low-grade spiritual stone hidden inside.
"Successful! We succeeded!" Ling Xiaoyu jumped up excitedly.
